1.visual: A downward-pointing arrow with a filled triangular head and a straight vertical shaft.

2.visual: A leftward-pointing arrow with a filled triangular head and a horizontal shaft.
2.usage: go back, previous page, return to prior step, carousel previous slide

3.visual: Two horizontal arrows stacked vertically pointing in opposite directions — one left on top, one right below.

4.visual: A rightward-pointing arrow with a filled triangular head and a horizontal shaft.

6.usage: sort column toggle, drag-to-reorder handle, vertical scroll indicator, swap item order

7.visual: A downward-pointing chevron — an open V-shape with no shaft, lighter weight than a full arrow.

9.usage: go to last page, fast-forward to end of media, jump to end of sequence

20.visual: A square with an arrow emerging from inside it and pointing diagonally outward toward the upper-right corner, indicating launch in a new window.

24.visual: Three horizontal lines of equal length and spacing stacked vertically, the classic hamburger menu symbol.
